verdict: Skyworks' standalone sales fell 5% to $1,046M and GAAP EPS dropped to $0.15 from $0.94 as $82M of restructuring and impairment charges hit the quarter — days before the Qorvo combination closed and turned it into a much larger, full-stack radio-frequency company.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: standalone net revenue of $1,046M vs $1,100M a year ago

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: diluted, vs $0.94 a year ago; non-GAAP EPS was $1.28

kpis.label: Combined revenue with Qorvo
kpis.note: September quarter, Skyworks plus Qorvo (which had an extra week worth ~$70M)

kpis.label: Free cash flow
kpis.note: $34M of operating cash flow minus $95M of capital expenditures

segments.name: Net revenue (single segment)
segments.note: Skyworks reports as a single segment, so there is no official revenue split for this standalone quarter. Its new Smartphone and Diversified Growth Markets categories start next quarter, after the Qorvo combination closed; combined September-quarter revenue including Qorvo was about $1,983M.

opex.name: R&D
opex.note: Research and development — designing the next generation of radio-frequency and mixed-signal chips; $213.5M as reported.

opex.name: SG&A
opex.note: Selling, general and administrative expenses — $109.3M as reported, shown as $110M so the rounded lines balance exactly.

opex.name: Restructuring & impairment
opex.note: Restructuring, impairment and other charges of $82.1M, including a $66.2M asset impairment charge — versus just $1.6M a year ago.

otherDetail: Below operating income: $22M of interest expense (actual $21.5M, much of it on financing raised for the Qorvo deal), partly offset by $9M of other income, gives net other expense of $13M. The tax line is a $14M benefit (actual $13.6M), which is why tax adds to profit in the $100 walk.
footerNote: Amounts are rounded to the nearest $M from the reported figures (revenue $1,045.7M, gross profit $427.4M, operating income $22.3M, net income $23.4M); SG&A is shown as $110M and gross profit as $428M so the rounded lines balance exactly.

takeaways.title: Charges crushed GAAP profit
takeaways.text: Restructuring, impairment and other charges jumped to $82.1M from $1.6M a year ago, including a $66.2M asset impairment. Operating income fell to $22M from $111M, and GAAP EPS to $0.15 — versus non-GAAP EPS of $1.28.

takeaways.title: The Qorvo deal redraws the company
takeaways.text: The Qorvo combination closed after quarter-end, so these results are Skyworks standalone. Together the two did about $1.98B of September-quarter revenue, and management targets $500M or more of annual cost savings within 24–36 months.

takeaways.title: Cash flow went negative
takeaways.text: Operating cash flow fell to $34M from $200M a year ago while capital expenditures — money spent on buildings and equipment — rose to $95M, leaving free cash flow at -$61M for the quarter (still +$229M for the full year).

oneTimers: $82.1M of restructuring, impairment and other charges (vs $1.6M a year ago), including a $66.2M asset impairment charge shown in the cash-flow statement.

The non-GAAP reconciliation also flags $66.4M of settlements, gains, losses and impairments and $35.7M of acquisition-related expenses for the quarter, largely tied to the Qorvo combination — these overlap with, and are not additional to, the GAAP charge lines above.
